title: Corporate Wellness & Website Discovery
tldr: First discovery call with Madison, a Utah-based massage therapist (13 years) and breathwork facilitator connected to Top Rock through her dad, Eddie, who knows Justin. Madison is pivoting from one-on-one massage to on-site corporate wellness — going into companies (targeting Silicon Slopes–sized employers) to deliver massage, breathwork, guided workouts/stretching, and health & wellness coaching, plus a layer of organizational psychology to drive a real ROI and culture change. She's burnt out on fishing for individual clients and wants to work with multiple people "at the source" of their tension. She needs a website that centers the corporate-wellness offering (while still surfacing massage + breathwork) — welcoming but "professional and sleek." Her business is Garden of Eden Wellness (an LLC renamed in January 2026 from "Garden of Eden Massage," a play on her last name), she loves jewel-tone green, and she builds her own logos/brand kits on Canva. Timeline is ~6 months — she wants the foundation in place by January 2027 (when her master's begins) so she can spend her time selling contracts. Top Rock explained its AI fast-iteration model: they'll transcribe this call, build a first mockup for free, then quote. Next step: Justin reaches back around Monday (July 6) with an initial mockup; Madison sends inspiration, photos, and logos to Austin's email.

Transcribe the call and build the first mockup direction(s) — jewel-tone green, corporate-wellness focus, with a consult-booking flow.
